title: Filter an item's history by field, day and author
notes: CLI, MCP and board: most readers want when the state or the assignee changed.
result: show --history takes --field, --since, --until and --author (each implies --history); the MCP show tool takes field, since, until and author; the board's History section filters locally by field chips, days and author
evidence: pytest: 1236 tests at 100% coverage, among them tests/test_filter_history.py, test_show_history_filters.py and test_board_history_js.py (the board's filterHistory equals filter_history for ten filters); a jsdom run against a live tadu board: chips, days, author, Clear and a filter kept over Reload
